run_findings.github_async_state_machine: Current GitHub async merge uses pending/merged/enqueued/failed. Pending carries uuid/method/action/expected_head_sha; merged carries details.sha; enqueued is terminal only for the async request and requires separate queue-final tracking; documented bound failure means no effect for that request group before queue admission.
run_findings.github_409_recovery: A 409 returns an existing async request UUID and explicitly warns that options may differ. Recovery must poll and compare expected_head_sha, merge_method and merge_action before adopting the request; never blind-retry.
run_findings.github_rule_suite_binding: Post-effect Rule Suite proof must match exact (ref,before_sha,after_sha) for every landed target-ref transition. Large stacks may split into consecutive merge groups, so complete evidence can require a chain of multiple suites rather than one final suite.
run_findings.github_rule_suite_result_semantics: Rule Suite result=pass is active-rule pass; result=bypass is effect via bypass and must not be classified PASS. evaluation_result is separate counterfactual/evaluate evidence; current examples permit active pass with evaluation_result=fail.
run_findings.github_stack_pr_fallback: Official github/gh-stack docs at exact commit 2bd699a544a09cb5c45a013d03416e0894b0454e document stack metadata on every stacked PR REST resource: id, number, size, position, ultimate base ref/SHA. Together with PR number/head SHA/direct base ref, a collector can reconstruct the member vector only when every position 1..size is present exactly once and the branch chain closes.
run_findings.github_stack_connected_uncertainty: Direct /stacks GET is connector-allowlist-blocked. Standard PR GET/list is allowed, but sampled connected PR results did not expose a stack field. Absence is not proof of standalone status because API-version/connector field omission remains possible; classify UNKNOWN_MEMBER_VECTOR until the actual connected PR representation proves the stack object is available.
run_findings.durability_windows: Async result is retained 24h. Rule Suite list discovery is bounded to time_period<=month, while exact suite detail is addressable by ID. Durable recovery should persist UUID/pending tuple, terminal result, member/final-effect evidence, matched suite IDs and exact suite readbacks promptly.
run_findings.connector_capability_boundary: Connected mutation schema exposes sync merge(expected_head_sha) and auto-merge but no async/stack/queue mutation. Generic async-result GET reaches GitHub; direct /stacks GET is blocked; Rule Suite GET reaches GitHub but is Administration:read permission-dependent. GitHub capability exceeds ordinary connected Chat coverage.
